interface.name: zwp_input_method_manager_v2
interface.description:
The input method manager allows the client to become the input method on a chosen wl_seat.
This request allows you to become an input method on a given wl_seat. When the compositor enables a text input for a seat, an activate event is sent to the input method.

request.name: get_input_method
request.description: This request puts the composite client in the role of an input method for a seat. The client should then use the returned object to handle text input on the seat.

interface.name: zwp_input_method_v2
interface.description:
An input method object is responsible for enabling and disabling input methods on a seat, and for composing and committing text.
Only one input method per seat can be active at a time.

event.name: activate

description.summary: input method has been requested to activate

event.description: Notification that this input method has been activated for a text-input on a seat.

event.name: deactivate
event.description: Notification that this input method has been deactivated for a text-input on a seat.

event.name: surrounding_text
event.description: Update on what surrounding text is around the cursor. Sent before done, after an activate event, and whenever the surrounding text changes while active.

event.name: text_change_cause

description.summary: indicates the cause of surrounding text change

event.description: Sent before done, after surrounding_text, indicating what caused the change of surrounding text.

event.name: content_type
event.description: Sent before done, indicating the content hint and purpose of the focused text input.

event.name: done
event.description: Sent after all other events belonging to a single state update.

event.name: unavailable
event.description: The input method has been disposed of, e.g. because another input method took over the seat, or the compositor shut down. The client should destroy this object.
